dedupe_keys.name: 水道水質テータヘース japan tap water quality database by water utility and treatment plant jwwa

description: The tap water quality database of the Japan Water Works Association publishes summaries of the water quality tests that Japanese water utilities and bulk water suppliers carry out; the Ministry of the Environment, which oversees drinking water, links it from its tap water quality data page. The database home page read on 2026-09-28 says it covers fiscal year 2021 onwards and the water quality standard items, the management target items and pesticides, with distribution tables of test values by raw or treated water and by water source, and individual data giving, for each treatment plant of every utility, the maximum, minimum and mean values and the number of tests for raw and treated water. Coverage is national, for public water supply and bulk supply utilities. Access is free on the web in Japanese; no licence is stated. Caveats: values are summaries per plant and year, not individual samples, earlier years are not in this edition, and plant locations are not given. It supports resilience and service performance studies of Japanese drinking water systems, such as source water quality risk by plant. No related Japanese water utility record is catalogued yet; the ministry also lists radioactivity test results.
